text:
sophia: quick ask — our EMEA office observes a local bridge day next Fri (office closed) but my team in NA still has weekly all hands. I planned a customer demo that day; can I swap to a floating holiday and request a partial remote handoff? cc @rahul
people-ops-bot: Reminder: regional observed holidays must be requested as "Regional Observed" or use floating. If cross-region coverage required, please note in request. https://hr.redwood.com/regions :globe_with_meridians:
rahul: if customer is in EMEA we can reschedule; if demo is fixed, propose doing it Mon or the following Wed. who owns the keycard / office access that day if you need to be onsite? cc @kari
sophia: demo fixed; client can't move. i can do it remotely but need a teammate to check the on-prem test rack for a hardware check at 08:30 local time. @ben can you do the 08:15 check? it'd be 01:15 PT for you.
ben: ouch that's overnight for me. i can if we compensate with a floating holiday swap or timebank. what's the formal process to swap in a different day off later?
kari: policy: "Employees may swap scheduled bridge days for floating holidays or take unpaid time, subject to manager approval and operational coverage." link: <https://hr.redwood.com/policies/bridge-days>. we have a Timebank feature so you can bank off-hours for later use; submit as "Timebank accrual request" in the portal.
people-ops-bot: Note: Timebank entries are reviewed weekly. Payroll cutoff for swaps is 4 business days before the pay period end.
mina: options: 1) ben does the check and we log a Timebank credit (requires Ben's consent), 2) schedule a different team member, or 3) have Sophia run the demo fully remote and book an engineering runbook check earlier today. whichever you choose, submit the time-off as "Regional Observed - floating" and tag coverage.
ben: i'm open to Timebank if i get equivalent off. will submit consent. one clarify: does Timebank convert to paid time off or unpaid?
rahul: Timebank is paid and can be redeemed as paid hours, but redemption requires manager signoff and is subject to blackout rules. see redemption rules in portal.
sophia: OK i'll submit request as "floating - regional observed" and tag @ben as on-call for rack check; @ben thanks for the help. also @mina can you confirm this won't consume my year-end carryover? i have 4.2 days carrying.
mina: because you're using a floating holiday, carryover stays intact. we will record the Timebank credit for Ben as 2.0 hours. please ensure Ben's consent is attached to the request before payroll cutoff.
ben: consent submitted via HR portal. thanks.
sophia: done, request submitted and added the runbook link and devops checklist. ping me if payroll needs anything else.
people-ops-bot: Notification: request 2919876543-1 submitted and queued for manager signoff. payroll note: swap window closes in 3 business days.
rahul: approved the coverage and the Timebank credit. thanks team. :thumbsup:
sophia: thanks all — saved the demo, avoided client delay. :clap:
mina: marked as approved and recorded Timebank. will follow up on payroll posting. have a smooth demo! :rocket:
